name: glass
title: Glass
description: A liquid glass lens that refracts live DOM through an SVG displacement filter, with chromatic dispersion and a bright rim, in Chrome, Safari and Firefox. No dependencies.
label: samasante liquid-glass
author: Sam Asante <https://github.com/samasante>

props.name: children
props.description: What the lens bends in place, or (with refract) the crisp layer on top.

props.name: refract
props.description: Bend a copy of this node instead (a panel over a photo); children render crisp on top.

props.name: behind
props.description: Fill for the thin bleed ring past a refract copy; auto reads the nearest solid ancestor background.

props.name: optics
props.description: The look: strength, depth, curvature, dispersion, bend, sheen, glow, frost, brightness...

props.name: size | width | height
props.description: Lens size in px; omit to fit the wrapped element.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px; omit to inherit the element's radius.

props.name: center
props.description: Lens center as fractions of the element (physical left and top, also in right-to-left pages).

props.name: src | draw | lenses
props.description: Refract a video or a canvas painter on the GPU (WebGL 2), with one or many lenses.

props.name: filterResolution
props.description: Chromium-only supersample (2 is crisper); forced to 1 in Safari.

props.name: live
props.description: Re-rasterize every frame when the refracted content animates by itself.

a11y: The lens is presentation: the refracted copy (refract, overlay) is aria-hidden and inert, so screen readers read the content once and its links stay out of the tab order.
Children keep their own semantics and focus order; the filter never intercepts pointer or keyboard input.
Reduced motion: animateGlassValue jumps to its target and useLensWobble does not squash or stretch.
Geometry (center, size) is physical, measured from the element's box, so a lens stays where it is placed in right-to-left pages.
